userStories.title: Implement BLE protocol module (protocol.py)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the BLE/GATT protocol implementation so that the server can communicate with the WalkingPad A1 Pro.
acceptanceCriteria: walkingpad_obs/protocol.py exists
GATT Service UUID 0000fe00-..., Write UUID 0000fe01-..., Notify UUID 0000fe02-... defined as constants
Packet builder creates bytes with format [0xF7][0xA2][CMD][...PARAMS][CHECKSUM][0xFD]
Checksum calculated as (sum of bytes from 0xA2 to last param) & 0xFF
WalkingPadStats dataclass with fields: distance_km, time_seconds, time_formatted, steps, speed_kmh, state, state_name, mode, mode_name, calories, connected, is_running

Status parser correctly reads state (byte 3), speed (bytes 4-5 big-endian /10), mode (byte 6), time (bytes 7-9 big-endian uint24), distance (bytes 10-12 big-endian /100), steps (bytes 13-15 big-endian uint24)
WalkingPadController class with connect, disconnect, start, stop, set_speed, request_status methods
Packet buffer handles fragmented BLE notifications (checks 0xF7 start and 0xFD end bytes)
Calorie estimation: ~55 kcal per km with 10% bonus above 4.0 km/h
to_dict() method on WalkingPadStats returns JSON-serializable dict
Python syntax check passes
userStories.notes: Read WALKINGPAD-OBS-SPEC.md section 'BLE-Protokoll' for exact byte offsets and command formats. Reference implementations: github.com/DorianRudolph/QWalkingPad and github.com/ph4r05/ph4-walkingpad

userStories.title: Implement FastAPI server with REST API and WebSocket (server.py)
userStories.description: As a user, I want a web server that connects to my WalkingPad and exposes REST API endpoints and a WebSocket for live data.
acceptanceCriteria: walkingpad_obs/server.py exists
CLI args: --mac (required), --host (default 0.0.0.0), --port (default 8777), --poll-interval (default 1.0), --verbose
GET / serves dashboard.html
GET /overlay serves overlay.html
GET /api/stats returns JSON with all WalkingPadStats fields
POST /api/start sends start command to WalkingPad and returns {status: 'ok'}
POST /api/stop sends stop command and returns {status: 'ok'}
POST /api/speed/{kmh} validates range 0.5-6.0 and sets speed, returns {status: 'ok', speed: float}
WebSocket /ws sends current status on connect, broadcasts on every status update, handles ping/pong keep-alive
Auto-reconnect to BLE device every 5 seconds on connection loss
Status polling every poll-interval seconds
Prints startup URLs to terminal (dashboard, overlay, API stats)
Python syntax check passes
userStories.notes: HTML files are served from the same directory as server.py using pathlib. Use FastAPI HTMLResponse for HTML routes.

userStories.title: Create OBS Browser Source overlay (overlay.html)
userStories.description: As a streamer, I want an OBS overlay that shows live WalkingPad stats (time, distance, steps, speed, calories) with a polished design.
acceptanceCriteria: walkingpad_obs/overlay.html exists
Self-contained HTML file with inline CSS and JS, no external frameworks
Transparent background for OBS Browser Source (800x200px)
Dark glassmorphism card with rgba(12,12,16,0.85) background and 16px border-radius
Horizontal layout: all 5 stats in one row with dividers between them

Stats displayed: Time (green #22d68a, MM:SS/H:MM:SS), Distance (white #e8e8ec, 0.00 km), Steps (purple #c084fc, with thousands separator), Speed (cyan #5be0f8, 0.0 km/h), Calories (orange #f8945b, 0 kcal)
Fonts: JetBrains Mono (Bold, 26px, tabular-nums) for values, Outfit (10px, uppercase) for labels, loaded via Google Fonts
Slide-in animation on load (translateY + scale with cubic-bezier)
Bump animation on value changes (scale to 1.08)
Pulsing status dot (6px, top-left): green+glow when connected, red when disconnected
Speed fill bar: background fills proportional to speed (max 6 km/h = 100%)
Active bar: glowing line under speed card when belt is running
Disconnected state: 50% opacity, all values gray
WebSocket connects to ws://{host}/ws with auto-reconnect (exponential backoff 1s to 10s) and 30s keep-alive ping
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Read WALKINGPAD-OBS-SPEC.md sections 'OBS Overlay' for exact design specs. All CSS and JS must be inline in the HTML file.
